en.html:
Four in the morning.

We began at the hour when sleep was deepest, chosen for precisely that reason.

We had already surveyed a route that would avoid the patrols. Keeping to the narrow blind spots between the watchtowers, we crept through the darkness.

...To be honest, I had misgivings. Probably I was overthinking it. Probably.

That Noh stage. How much had been intended by that warning? And the gaze of that strange man...

The more I considered it, the more my suspicions grew. Even so, postponement was out of the question.

午前四時。
　最も眠りの深い時刻を見計らい、行動を開始した。

　警邏隊と出くわさぬ道順は事前に調査済み。
　物見櫓のわずかな死角から死角をつき、夜陰の中を
潜行する。

　……正直、懸念はあった。
　考え過ぎであろうとは思う――が。

　あの能舞台。あの<ruby>見せしめ<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>には、果たしてどこまで
の意味があったのか。
　そしてあの奇態な男の視線……。

　思う都度、疑惑は増す。
　だがそれでも、延期は論外と考えざるを得なかった。

en.html:
Stopping Ichijou was no longer possible. If I took time to investigate, she would act alone while I was doing it.

That would be leaving her to die. This girl knew only how to go straight ahead; I could not believe that any operation left to her would succeed.

Would she build a mountain of corpses, then fall dead on top of it? For nothing.

I could not allow that. Preventing such a pointless ending was the reason I was going with her.

I had abandoned postponement, but had somehow talked her out of the change of plan she wanted—an assassination attempt on Doushin Yusa. I had explained that there was no prospect of success.

...Though success or failure should have had nothing to do with stopping that plan.

If there had been even a chance of success, how earnestly would I have tried to stop her? I could not answer that myself.

一条を制止するのはもはや、無理だ。
　俺が調査に時間を費やせば、その間に単独で行動を
起こすだろう。

　それでは見殺しになる。
　この直進しか知らぬ少女の意に任せて、事が成ると
は思えない。

　屍の山を築いた挙句、その頂点へ伏せるだろうか。
　意味もなく。

　そうはさせられなかった。
　無意味な死屍累々の結末など迎えさせぬために、俺
が同行しているのだ。

　行動の延期は諦めたが、一条が望んだ作戦変更――
遊佐童心の襲殺――はどうにか説き伏せて断念させた。
　成功の見込みが無いと<ruby>諭<rt>さと</rt></ruby>して。

　……見込み云々とは関係なく、それは止めねばなら
ぬところであろうが。
　もし万一にも成功が望めたなら、俺もどこまで本気
で一条を制止したか。我ながら不明であった。

岩田"...Then, shall we. I go first, then Ayane ji. Minato ji, kindly take the rear."
Kageaki"Understood."
Ichijou"So, how are we doing this? I heard you were getting us inside."
岩田"We enter the main keep through the back door that the inner maids use. At night it is normally locked, but tonight I have seen to it that it stays open."
岩田"Once we are inside, the rest is not difficult."
Ichijou"Is that so. ...Minato, when do we armor?"
Kageaki"Right before we move from infiltration to assault. It is still too early."
Kageaki"The moment we armor, at least every warrior guarding the main keep will probably notice us and come rushing. We must aim for the very last moment."
Ichijou"Understood."

en.html:
岩田"Speed is the life of this operation. The moment you judge the objective sufficiently achieved, withdraw at once."
岩田"If they seal the airspace around the castle, it is all over. Get out of the castle before that, at any cost."
Kageaki"We are aware."
Ichijou"And you?"
岩田"If an attack on His Highness Kuniuji takes place, and at the same time a new hire of the Mandokoro vanishes, the matter becomes obvious. I introduced that new hire, so I cannot escape questioning either. Therefore..."
岩田"Once I have guided you, I shall leave straight from there. Please do not worry."
Ichijou"Worried? Main tumhari nurse nahin—I'm not getting stuck looking after you as well, Rokuhara. That is all."
岩田"...Oh? Is that so."
Kageaki(Muramasa. How are the surroundings?)
Muramasa《No anomaly. That does not mean it is peaceful, of course.》
Muramasa《Security is as tight as ever. Still, with someone who knows the inside as our guide, we should slip through...》
Muramasa《Provided that longhorn beetle over there does not become dead weight.》
正宗《Say what thou wilt, spider. Unlike such lawless creatures as thee, I find no shame in being ill suited to skulking in darkness.》
Muramasa《...¦ Kya kehne. Defective performance, and too grand to be ashamed! Are you sword-armor or not? But naturally, the nation's finest must have a breadth of mind beyond the rest of us.》
正宗《...》
Muramasa《...》

でも劒冑？　さすが天下一名物ともなると器
が違うのね》
正宗
